text_block_list.text: Now, the time for revenge has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...They say in entertainment, you sometimes have to bring the mood down before building it back up, but—"

Everyone's waiting to see me win!
choice_data_list: I'll give back all the love I owe you for making you wait!

text_block_list.text: Yes! All this love that's been piling up... I'll return it with all my might!
